summary: Frontend web-preview testing for DailyHub AI covering Premium 'Coming Soon' screen, AI rate-limit dialog, Profile settings rows, and Home/Tools navigation. 22/22 test assertions PASS. All requested testIDs present. Premium page renders with Coming Soon badge, correct title/subtitle, all 6 feature cards (sparkles, cloud-upload, close-circle, color-palette, download, rocket), disabled 'Coming Soon' button (aria-disabled=true), locked-cta and notify-card visible. Back navigation works. No purchase API call triggered. AI limit flow: guest sent 5 chat messages successfully, 6th returned HTTP 429 and ai-limit-dialog appeared with correct title 'reached today's free AI limit', watch-ad, try-tomorrow, and coming-soon rows. Watch Ad on web shows expected error 'Ads are only available on the mobile app'. Try-Tomorrow closes dialog. Profile: Theme picker (dark/light/system), Language picker (en/hi), Notifications toggle, Restore alert, Storage refresh, Privacy Policy screen, Terms & Conditions screen, App Lock PIN 4-digit set + confirm flow all work; the expected web-only 'Failed to save PIN' error appears from pin-error testID (documented as expected on web). Logout returns to /login. Home and Tools tabs load without crash.

ui_bugs.issue: The entire row is NOT tappable to toggle the Switch — only the Switch thumb itself accepts taps. Users tapping the row label (as is standard mobile UX) will see nothing happen. Ref: /app/frontend/app/(main)/profile.tsx lines 597-622 (ToggleRow). Fix: wrap in Pressable or add onPress to the row that calls onValueChange(!value).

react_native_issues.issue: Console warnings observed on web: 'shadow* style props are deprecated. Use boxShadow', 'Image: style.resizeMode is deprecated. Please use props.resizeMode', 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. These are informational RN Web deprecation warnings; not blocking but should be cleaned up before release.

action_items: (Optional/LOW) Make ToggleRow row-level tappable (wrap in Pressable with onPress={()=>onValueChange(!value)}) so tapping label toggles the switch — better mobile UX.
(Cosmetic) Replace deprecated RN Web style props: shadow* → boxShadow, style.resizeMode → props.resizeMode, props.pointerEvents → style.pointerEvents.
critical_code_review_comments: premium/index.tsx: no purchase API call anywhere in the file — confirmed 'Coming Soon' semantics. Button is disabled and no onPress handler present. Good.
AILimitDialog.tsx: correctly checks ADS_ENABLED (Platform.OS === android/ios) before invoking rewarded ad SDK — graceful web fallback works as designed.
profile.tsx (~903 lines) is getting large; consider splitting PickerModal + PIN modal into standalone components to keep the file focused on the screen composition.
ads/rewarded.web.ts and other .web.ts stubs correctly resolve false/no-op so web preview doesn't break.
seed_data_creation: Each test run creates a fresh guest session via /api/auth/guest at login. Guest quota resets per user so the 5-then-429 flow is reproducible. No cleanup required.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Frontend tests exercised via Playwright at http://localhost:3000 (mobile viewport 375x812). Guest login flow reliable. AI chat 5→429 flow takes ~30-60s (5 real Gemini calls). SecureStore is unavailable on web so PIN save always returns false → pin-error text 'Failed to save PIN. Try again.' is EXPECTED on web, NOT a bug. AdMob SDK is a no-op on web (rewarded returns false) — AILimitDialog surfaces the 'Ads are only available on the mobile app' message.
